name: Kitkat
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Milk solids, Refined wheat flour (Maida), Hydrogenated vegetable fats (contain sesame oil), Edible vegetable fats, Cocoa solids (4.4%), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin), Raising agent (500(ii)), Yeast, Flour treatment agents (516 and 1101(i)) and iodized salt. CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR (ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES) MAY CONTAIN PEANUTS.
